subject.title: fix(cost): align token usage refresh cadence with global settings

question: Should token/cost scans follow the exact global scheduler semantics, including no automatic work in Manual and live Adaptive delays, or remain independently throttled?
rationale: The existing UI documents a separate hourly cost cadence, while the proposed coupling can substantially increase local scan frequency, so repository intent is required before changing that policy.

options.title: Share global schedule
options.body: Run token/cost eligibility from the same fixed, Manual, and live Adaptive cadence decisions as provider usage.

options.title: Keep independent throttle
options.body: Retain a separate cost-scan policy and expose accurate copy or a dedicated setting rather than implying one global cadence.

recommendation.title: Share global schedule
recommendation.body: Run token/cost eligibility from the same fixed, Manual, and live Adaptive cadence decisions as provider usage.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice changes the app-wide refresh contract and local cost-scan policy centered in UsageStore.
